name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Inbound leads go cold fast, and the rep who responds first with a relevant question usually wins the meeting. I spent four years as a BDR qualifying leads and booking sales-ready meetings for regional reps, then moved into SaaS sales at Fivestars, where I made up to 150 calls a day and closed up to 10 deals a month, and Accelo, where I ranked top three on a team of 8 to 15 while quota roughly doubled.

I've also built the other side of the process. At my consulting business, Solenzo, I design automated lead capture, routing, and follow-up systems so no inbound lead waits for a response, and at Level Agency I reported on which campaigns actually produced quality leads. That makes me a useful partner to marketing when it comes to feedback on lead quality. I work in Salesforce daily and have used HubSpot, ZoomInfo, Salesloft, and Apollo.
I'm based in Arvada, so the Denver office is close if hybrid works better for the team. I'd welcome a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
